members.name: Dhanatyashree Yurembam
members.bio: Dhanatyashree is a dynamic individual with strong leadership and teamwork skills. She is a Bachelor of Commerce (Hons.) graduate from the University of Delhi. As General Secretary of the North East Student Group while in college, she has demonstrated her ability to manage and motivate teams effectively. She is adaptable, with excellent communication skills, and thrives in collaborative environments. Dhanatyashree’s involvement in extracurricular activities, including participation in the 2024 G20 Meet in JDMC and earning an NCC ‘C’ Certificate, reflects her discipline and commitment to personal growth. Known for her critical thinking and time management abilities, she excels in diverse roles while maintaining a positive and proactive attitude.

members.name: Mangalsana Khomdram
members.bio: Mangalsana, a very giving person who enjoys working alongside other like-minded people who want to make a difference in the work and suited to the position of volunteer. He is member of MitSna since 2019 and carry on with the executive position. He maintained a good academic record in his high school life. He graduated with Bachelor's degree of Physics honours from DM College of Science, Manipur University. He has completed one year course on Office Automation (PCOA 2020-21) under Pointrex IIT . He is currently pursuing PG Diploma Course in Banking and Finance at MIMS, Manipur University. With love of volunteering, he is a life time member at IRCS. He loves games and sports since childhood. He played Football, Karate, Boxing and Judo in earlier period of his life. And now, he is a State Muay Thai player. One of his hobby is listening to music.
